description: 18-bot official-judge round robin, 153 matches, 306000 played hands.

aurora.name: Aurora PLO5-MCCFR
aurora.runtime_backend: Built-in NumPy fallback; bundled Linux .so cannot load on Windows. No opponent source changes.

manifest.method: One official match per pair. Seats swapped; fresh server processes per half; normal startup, error and time limits. Two concurrent lanes with disjoint physical cores: each server pinned to a performance core, each judge to an efficiency core. One BLAS/OMP thread per process. Local Windows, not Docker. No earlier standalone comparisons reused; completed pairings within this tournament were retained when Aurora joined. Revisions frozen before play.
manifest.scoring: Official match win=1, draw=0.5, loss=0. Ties: mini-league points among tied entrants, then average bb per duplicate deal.

roster_extension.note: Preserved all completed pairings; interrupted unfinished matches restart with fresh servers. Existing source revisions, seed, limits and CPU lanes unchanged.

limitations: One shared deal seed; some opponents have unseeded randomness. Local Windows, not Docker. This run does not establish a guaranteed best strategy. Match verdicts use the official 95% interval; leaderboard ties use mini-league points then mean bb per duplicate deal.

aurora_backend_check.note: Original repository tests passed on Windows/NumPy after the tournament. 550 diagnostic hands are separate from the 306000 scored tournament hands.
